unresolved_entries.rationale: Bounded dynamic module-name generation for compiled security detector code synthesized in-memory (compile_in_memory/2); module_name identifies the freshly synthesized module itself, not a reference to an existing cross-app module.

Bounded Jido action dispatch under Arbor.Actions.* built from String.to_existing_atom(category_mod/action_mod) and validated via Code.ensure_loaded?/1 before use; cannot mint new atoms or resolve arbitrary modules outside the existing action registry.

Bounded agent template module resolution under Arbor.Agent.Templates.* from a template name, gated by Code.ensure_loaded?/1 and function_exported?/3 before use; module_name is derived from a known template identifier, not arbitrary input.

name is reconstructed from the AST currently being inspected by the app-env inventory so analyzed module references can be normalized; it describes analyzed source and is not a runtime repository coupling edge.

parts is reconstructed from the AST currently being inspected by the app-env inventory so aliases and remote calls can be classified; it describes analyzed source and is not a runtime repository coupling edge.
name is extracted from generated candidate code being compiled and graded and is used only to purge the synthesized module afterward; it does not reference an Arbor repository module.
name is extracted from submitted candidate code and is used only to purge compiled test modules after grading; it does not reference an Arbor repository module.

module_parts is derived from the AST of code submitted into the sandbox for policy-violation scanning (walk_ast/3); it names modules appearing in externally-submitted sandboxed code, not in Arbor's own repository source, so it is not a repository coupling edge.
